taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we examine the resistivity values of the six layers in depth order:
1. $r_1 = 104.3$
2. $r_2 = 416.7$
3. $r_3 = 264.5$
4. $r_4 = 856.9$
5. $r_5 = 641.5$
6. $r_6 = 7698.1$

Next, we apply the rules for each group of three consecutive layers:
- **Layers 1-2-3**: (104.3, 416.7, 264.5) $\rightarrow r_1 < r_2$ and $r_2 > r_3$, which corresponds to **K**.
- **Layers 2-3-4**: (416.7, 264.5, 856.9) $\rightarrow r_2 > r_3$ and $r_3 < r_4$, which corresponds to **H**.
- **Layers 3-4-5**: (264.5, 856.9, 641.5) $\rightarrow r_3 < r_4$ and $r_4 > r_5$, which corresponds to **K**.
- **Layers 4-5-6**: (856.9, 641.5, 7698.1) $\rightarrow r_4 > r_5$ and $r_5 < r_6$, which corresponds to **H**.

Combining these letters in order gives the curve type KHKH.

{"curve_type": "KHKH"}
